meeting: VPP Insiders session two: the business opportunity and the value chain
note: Three panellists — a vertically integrated utility, a SaaS platform, and a V2G startup. Two things make this the strongest fixture of the public five: the utility states its decarbonization deadline twice with different end dates, and the startup describes an EV financing model in detail and then says it has never financed a vehicle. Both reward reading to the end. Attributed by role and company, not by the names panellists give.
